title: Cold brew
creator: nuncavi1cientista
steps: Use a 1:8 ratio of coffee to water (31 g for 250 ml, 62.5 g for 500 ml, 125 g for 1 litre).
Leave covered in a glass container, at room temperature or in the fridge, for at least 12 hours (up to 24), then strain.
Dilute 1:1 with water, milk or another drink to serve.
notes: 180 ml of cold brew has about 200 mg of caffeine, roughly twice a cup of filter coffee.
